title: Apply for {{role_title}} at {{company_name}}
description: Thank you for applying. This form takes about {{apply_minutes}} minutes. We read every application ourselves and look at job related answers first. Your resume and answers are redacted (name, contact details and links removed) before they are scored, and a person makes every decision. Need an adjustment to take part? Write to {{contact_email}}.
notes_for_owner: Ask only what you need to judge the job. Every question must map to a scorecard criterion or to logistics (contact, location rule, right to work, start date).
Never add questions about age, date of birth, gender, photo, marital status, family plans, nationality, religion, health or disability.
Replace the 3 role specific slots with questions from templates/forms/screening-questions.md that match your scorecard.
Do not mark any answer as an automatic reject. A person reviews every application.
Check local rules on what you may ask and how long you may keep the data. Not legal advice.

sections.title: Privacy and consent
sections.description: We use your information only for this hiring process. We keep it for {{retention_period}} after the decision and then delete it. You can ask us to see, correct or delete it at any time by writing to {{contact_email}}. Who sees it: {{who_sees_it}}. Some of the review uses software to sort and summarize answers, but a person reads the results and makes every decision. Not legal advice: have your privacy notice checked for your region.

questions.help: If you choose 'I do not agree', we cannot use your application.

questions.label: Optional: you may keep my details for {{retention_period_long}} so you can contact me about similar roles.

sections.title: Making the process work for you (optional)
sections.description: We welcome applicants of all backgrounds. Anything you write here is not used for scoring and is not shown to the people who score applications. It is used only to adjust the process (for example a different format or more time).

questions.label: Is there anything that would help the process work for you? (optional)
questions.help: For example: extra time, a written format, an accessible meeting room.
